description: The source is a flat mauve 0x8060a0 -- three channels, all mid-range and all different -- so every knob moves it visibly and none of them moves it by accident. Saturation at 0.0 takes it to its own Rec.709 luma, a flat grey around 0x6b. A build averaging the three channels instead of weighting them lands on a different grey and fails here; one applying saturation after the temperature would land on a third.
